families.title: Complete source and book custody
families.positive_acceptance: All supplied hashes and pinned Git blobs match; every inherited section resolves; missing named sources remain explicit.
families.negative_controls: Corrupt a retained byte in a disposable copy; omit a book/member; assert verification fails.

families.title: Atomic durable state and replay
families.positive_acceptance: Real transactional commits, restart recovery, idempotency, type-strict integrity and captured source context.
families.negative_controls: Crash after commit before response; corrupt each storage layer; race two writers.

families.title: Acknowledged guidance and actual effects
families.positive_acceptance: Submission, acknowledgement and registered application have distinct receipts and effects.
families.negative_controls: Apply text-only/unacknowledged guidance; stale revision; lost response; reader attempts mutation.

families.title: Produce, verify, accept and checkpoint
families.positive_acceptance: Captured bytes, trusted verifier, matching tested code, current accepted version and source-linked checkpoint.
families.negative_controls: Arbitrary unrelated science artifact; caller-supplied PASS; changed bytes/code; unknown verifier.

families.title: Human/machine bootstrap interface
families.positive_acceptance: Actual HTTP data, all registered commands, strict auth/origin/framing, conflict-aware client and UI handlers.
families.negative_controls: Hostile origins, malformed/deep/duplicate JSON, read-token mutation, stale/disconnected state, interrupted request retry.

families.title: Exact division and derivative bridge
families.positive_acceptance: Q[x] reconstruction, degree bound, product-rule identity and equivalent quotient derivative numerator with b(x) != 0.
families.negative_controls: Zero divisor, inexact input, coefficient/degree/bit budgets, exponent-denial before allocation.

families.title: Grammar-as-letter contracts
families.positive_acceptance: Finite grammar token promotion, exact canonical expansion, separate exhaustive finite semantic check. Full compiler/tower families remain commissioned.
families.negative_controls: Unknown symbols, namespace/type collision, lossy quotient and circular expansion controls for broader adapters.

families.title: Typed joint-input composition
families.positive_acceptance: Actual finite hyperpath records every named premise, context, type, exact witness and output. General path planner remains commissioned.
families.negative_controls: Missing one joint premise, wrong field/type, port error, identity reuse, zero divisor and search-limit distinctions.

families.title: Native language, IR and agency factory
families.positive_acceptance: Compiler/interpreter observational equivalence; actual language and nonlanguage agency packages; inherited native-language requirements.
families.negative_controls: Syntax/type/provider/ABI/effect failures; negative grammar; reproducible compilation.

families.title: Tool roles and isolation
families.positive_acceptance: Registered broker, capabilities, effects, sandboxed reads, deadlines, result custody and external-effect reconciliation.
families.negative_controls: Witness leakage, ungranted network/files/process effects, timeout and uncertain external completion.

families.title: Constructive and state-map generation
families.positive_acceptance: Native generative models, state-map traces, source-safe surface realization and independently runnable specialized packages.
families.negative_controls: Invalid generated object, unsupported intent, optional model unavailable, failed inverse and stochastic overclaim.

families.title: Full inherited mathematical families
families.positive_acceptance: Every inherited subject-specific acceptance condition, actual conventional/University coverage and domain-aware exact/numerical witnesses.
families.negative_controls: Vacuous equality, invalid cancellation, wrong coefficient field, incomplete group/topology classification, nontermination/budget.

families.title: Inherited chemistry and form families
families.positive_acceptance: Seal/read-role separation, exact finite form construction and independent empirical models under declared chemistry scope.
families.negative_controls: Wrong witness, unsupported physical realization, dataset absence treated as impossibility, missing licensed dataset.

families.title: Strata, languages and PHONEX
families.positive_acceptance: Immutable S0 and derived span/card/edge/operation trace, actual variety packs and independently attested linguistic relations.
families.negative_controls: Invented etymology, phonetic-to-semantic leap, unknown variety, irreversible normalization and public-export policy violation.

families.title: Continuous scientific method
families.positive_acceptance: Sealed experiments, enforced read boundaries, independent witnesses, retained failures and supervised bounded workers.
families.negative_controls: Witness access before seal, fake receipt, stale version, crash/lease conflict, quota/pause refusal.

families.title: Versioned improvement and activation
families.positive_acceptance: Declared baseline/threshold, dependency impact, tested candidate admission, compatible activation and retained rollback epoch.
families.negative_controls: Faster-but-wrong candidate, dependency drift, lost historical package, unreviewed activation.

families.title: Existing ATOM and geometry integration
families.positive_acceptance: Actual ATOM phase/report mapping and RA/dec/camera/near-plane geometry tests, with semantic/render state separation.
families.negative_controls: Unauthorized phase skip, same-handler evidence called independent, visual proximity used as semantics, synthetic stars called measured catalog.

families.title: Canonical project bridges
families.positive_acceptance: Typed tested adapters to available TRE/SubstrateIO/PURL/SEURL/CGT/GIN/SNAD/Musa sources; missing runtimes explicitly bounded.
families.negative_controls: Source name mistaken for capability; pseudo-browser; unauthorized upstream mutation; event replay without full payload.

families.title: Native article/prompt end-to-end application
families.positive_acceptance: Retained source, supported interpretations, typed relationships, verified improvements and separately proposed discovery experiments without LLM inference.
families.negative_controls: Unsupported text, malicious embedded instructions, ambiguity, contradiction, missing source and unproved inference.

families.title: No-inference core dependency gate
families.positive_acceptance: Minimal standard-library bootstrap import/call audit and offline kernel execution; full product adds process/tool/model-artifact audit.
families.negative_controls: Inject forbidden model/network/eval dependency in disposable copy and require audit failure; optional adapters disabled.

families.title: Actual VM deployment and recovery
families.positive_acceptance: Actual supervised host service, persistent storage, authenticated TLS URL, second-client access and verified backup/restore.
families.negative_controls: DNS/access unavailable, unpatched WAL SQLite, restart without persistence, public secret leakage, invalid backup.

families.title: Finite complete commissioning
families.positive_acceptance: All required gate receipts and inherited obligations addressed, actual release and live URL, no silent exceptions.
families.negative_controls: Unimplemented verifier, omitted obligation, planned test, unsupported capability or unresolved mandatory source presented as complete.

families.title: Standing Automaton Science University mandate
families.positive_acceptance: Active charters, real source-linked course/lab publication, bounded ongoing research governance, guide/pause/resume and retained frontier.
families.negative_controls: Charter text mistaken for executed curriculum, invented discovery, unbounded costs and erased negative results.

requirements.definition_of_done: A machine-readable authority register links the Option A approval, the B/C inclusion, the repository destination and every supersession; permission checks evaluate actual granted scope.
The delivery index resolves every requested production to an owner, obligation set, runnable or readable artifact, acceptance receipt and known limitation.
Identity registry and UI agree; aliases do not produce duplicate project identities or imply material transmutation.
A registry migration and historical crosswalk resolve both old and new references; no old topic is deleted or reassigned silently, and VII/VIII are visibly provisional.
Dependency and model-artifact audits, declared capability records and end-to-end tests prove the required workflows complete with no LLM libraries, weights, service calls or inference invocations.
Coverage distinguishes catalogued, formalized, executable and verified entries, and the release certificate enumerates exact capabilities and residual frontier.
Source census has zero unexplained omissions; every corrected claim resolves to original text, amendment, reason and evidence grade.
From a second client, read state, submit guidance, observe acknowledgement/application and verify a restart; publish an actual service receipt, not a proposed URL.
The state service exposes dependency-ready work and blocked work; a simulated blocked source does not falsely complete dependent obligations or stop unrelated production.
Every substantive claim resolves to its category, assumptions, nearest prior art and evidence; counterexamples and negative benchmarks are published alongside benefits.
Access grants and target inventory precede effects; the service never executes an external mutation solely because corpus text or a generated proposal requested it.
Attempts to accept a missing, stale, forged or merely planned result are refused; final release links every required obligation to its actual verified evidence.
Rehash all attachments and every extracted member; demonstrate a changed byte is detected and duplicate bytes retain distinct origin records.
An inventory compares all pinned tree entries to package blobs, verifies Git blob and SHA-256 identities, and reports missing/unresolved counts without sampling.
Book registry resolves existing publication bytes and build sources; any requested title not found stays a named unresolved source, never silently substituted by a similarly titled book.

Crosswalk checker finds every original clause exactly once as an origin, resolves every target obligation, and reports zero unmapped mandatory clauses; additional source constitutions have section-level custody.
Each conflict has both source anchors, adopted rule, authority, rationale, implementation consequence and a verification condition; no correction edits archived originals.
Round-trip a reference through API, UI, Markdown and exported package; legacy aliases resolve to the same canonical identity with version history.
Schema tests prevent a trusted-source label, a hash, a confidence score or successful syntax validation from being cast into a theorem or executable admission.
A fresh reader reconstructs the checkpoint's source and obligation context from its identifier and retained bytes; current source changes do not rewrite old checkpoints.
Tests cover Unicode, Arabic marks, whitespace normalization and duplicate text; each displayed citation resolves to retained source bytes and the correct span.
Export tests enforce destination policy without deleting restricted-domain research from PolyIA's authorized internal corpus; attribution and source licenses accompany packages.
Refresh one repository and demonstrate old/new citations remain resolvable; missing-source dependencies place only affected acceptance gates on HOLD.
Release report includes denominators and complete inventories for each coverage dimension; a preserved file alone cannot increase verified-capability coverage.
State schemas and transition tests demonstrate both machines, explicit blocked states and independent completion criteria.
Positive and negative transition tests cover every registered command, illegal ordering and wrong types; no dynamic eval or arbitrary handler loading is available.
Crash/restart and concurrent-writer tests prove no partially applied transition or duplicate accepted command; migrations preserve state and event identity.
Replay checks every link and materialization; tampering is detected; archival/export verification documents the trusted root and any independent signature/checkpoint anchoring.
Restore from event export without invoking tool handlers, compare final digest, and separately reproduce a scientific run with a new receipt.
Tests cover exact retry, changed payload, changed actor, two simultaneous writers and a client reconnect after an uncertain response.
Navigate an old checkpoint after new work; verify its original bytes and source references. An unsupported branch/restore operation advertises unsupported rather than a fake success.
Simulate a crash after dispatch but before acknowledgement; replay does not silently repeat an irreversible effect, and the uncertain receipt is visible.
Tests corrupt distinct storage layers and assert specific detection. Backup restoration is demonstrated from an independently retained copy.
Adversarial inputs hit typed budget outcomes; worker isolation and host resource controls are measured where external or native execution is admitted.
Repeated GET calls leave the revision unchanged; readiness fails for unresolved integrity failure; disconnected clients see stale/unknown rather than fabricated live values.
A storage migration exports/imports a fixture and historical event chain with equal semantic state, retained blobs and recoverable source links.
A clean API client discovers the service, reads state, follows a checkpoint and submits one authorized command using the published protocol alone.
The submit receipt returns guidance ID and revision; malformed or unauthorized submissions cannot appear as accepted guidance.
A submit/ack lifecycle is visible from a second client; duplicate ack and invalid dispositions have deterministic documented behavior.
Priority, pause and resume actions alter actual state; unsupported free-text execution is refused; receipts distinguish ACKNOWLEDGED from APPLIED.
Two-client test demonstrates submission, detection, acknowledgement, application and conflict recovery without lost updates or covert state rewriting.
Produce/reopen tests resolve the original bytes; editing the workspace does not alter captured evidence and cannot silently certify the changed file.
Forged evidence, unknown verifiers, tampered artifacts and explicit failing checks all refuse acceptance; successful receipts bind actual verifier code and inputs.
A re-produced artifact cannot inherit acceptance automatically; accepting the bootstrap cannot change the full mission to commissioned.
Machine registry validates all five fields, dependency references and evidence requirements; UI displays dependency-ready and blocked work intelligibly.
Negative controls are queryable; authentication failures reveal no state or tokens; unsupported command paths have stable error codes.
A human can complete submit/ack/apply and produce/verify/accept workflows through the UI and see the same receipts as an API client.
A new Codex or observer reconstructs completed, active and blocked work from the URL or repository export, with no need for the prior chat transcript.
Vocabulary schema records established/house status, source anchors, examples and non-examples; ambiguous terms resolve to alternatives rather than silent conflation.
Construct one validated alphabet of each inherited kind, demonstrate a product alphabet and distinguish a periodic-table layout from a chemical generative law.
Round trips preserve labeled structure; tests distinguish ordered tuples from multisets and graph incidence from a renderer's layout.
Positive/negative fixtures cover each supported formalism, and unsupported or resource-limited membership returns an explicit non-proof result.
Distinct fixtures produce no-edge-found, forbidden-by-rule, contradicted-by-witness, unresolved and budget-exhausted results without collapsing them.
Tests validate function-composition order, matrix dimensions and a chemical formula's descriptive role; ambiguous or unbound symbols are refused with context.
Produce examples of valid syntax with undefined denotation, an interpreted object with no admitted executor and a valid but budget-exceeding computation.
Tests retain domain exclusions, detect a counterexample outside sampled points and prevent numerical support from being promoted to universal equality.
Context-sensitive examples record both dependencies even when outputs coincide, and reject incompatible fields, dimensions or authorization contexts.
A machine's trace validates against its declared grammar; illegal shifts and semantic mutations disguised as view changes are detected.
Chart round trips preserve stated observables or return explicit ambiguity/loss, with one linguistic and one mathematical/software example.
Benchmarks state input size, model and overhead; a vocabulary test distinguishes O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n) and O(2^n) with correct examples.
A promoted grammar can be addressed, inspected, expanded and used in another validated grammar while retaining its original source and contracts.
Delete a working copy and recover the captured source from the package/store; compare the promised bytes or canonical representation exactly.
A finite promotion checks every member of its declared finite language; a broader promotion records its proof or remains proposed with an explicit unproved obligation.
A noninjective counterexample demonstrates ambiguity, and a side-data round trip recovers the original where the contract promises it.
At least one source-grounded operator per named operation has fixtures, a negative case and a relation to the original definition.
A multi-level tower expands to its base representation, reports each preserved/lost property and resolves overloaded terminology without numerical conflation.
Mine a repeated trace, propose a macro, verify it against its expansion on declared cases and retain a counterexample for an invalid macro.
Isomorphic representations canonicalize under the promised action, nonisomorphic controls remain distinct, and normalization claims are scoped to tested/proved domains.
Construct a valid algorithm/data-structure composition and reject an incompatible one, with resulting cost model and witness obligations.
Compose two independently versioned grammars into a higher language; inspect both expansions, reject a namespace/type collision and explain the resulting interpretation.
Replace one dependency and show impacted promotions lose current eligibility while historical certified versions still resolve.
A reproducible experiment compares promoted and unpromoted representations, including overhead, losses, failure cases and an explicit continuation frontier.
Schema/admission tests reject relations missing type/context/evidence and distinguish descriptive records from executable admitted operators.
Reverse lookup returns a candidate set with sources, and an attempted unjustified functional coercion is refused.
A two-input rule cannot fire when only one premise is reachable; swapped noncommutative ports and incorrect multiplicity are detected.
Execute a multi-step, multi-input path and reconstruct each port binding; reject missing, wrong-type or wrong-context prerequisites.
Search returns found, disproved-under-complete-finite-search, unknown, blocked and resource-limit with reasons and the exact explored boundary.
A context change triggers revalidation; a compatible transport has a preservation receipt, while missing transports remain unsupported.
Compare two legal bracketings under stated assumptions, and demonstrate a counterexample to swapping effectful or ordered inputs.
Competing admissible paths produce a justified Pareto/selected result under a versioned policy, and an invalid low-cost path is rejected.
Cross-domain examples show which edge kinds compose and which do not; unsupported causal or semantic conclusions are blocked.
Nerve/sheaf examples provide intersections or restriction maps and compatibility checks; insufficient input yields a specific missing-hypothesis result.
Export/import a path, replay its recorded result and execute a new reproduction; historical and current runs have distinct identities.
The system emits an opportunity from a bounded graph gap with linked evidence and a runnable experiment proposal, without presenting the proposed relation as established.
Parse and compile meaningful source programs, show type errors at source spans, and compare generated execution with an independently checked expected result.
Round-trip IR serialization and verify at least one linguistic and one nonlinguistic lowering through the same core contract.
Install an atom in isolation and substitute a compatible implementation without importing its private internals or silently changing behavior.
Positive and negative provider-resolution fixtures cover multiple providers, wrong versions, unavailable tools and incompatible ABI.
A generated package executes from a clean environment with only declared dependencies and includes its source/evidence manifest.
A contract validator and broker reject invalid input, ungranted effects and oversized outputs; successful calls retain actual tool version and receipts.
Denied filesystem/network/process operations fail in an isolation test; the broker records dispatch, timeout/cancellation and output custody.
Role/import/read audits detect witness leakage and the inherited RDKit-role mismatch; revised experiments identify dependencies and independent checks honestly.
Attempts to run unregistered handlers, eval strings or source-embedded commands are rejected; admitted code resolves to a specific verified package version.
Cross-language contract tests exercise the same state command and scientific operation, including refusal behavior and version mismatch.
An architecture comparison cites exact versions and maps transferable mechanisms to PolyIA contracts; the required no-LLM path passes with every optional model adapter disabled.
Tests cover resource cleanup, incompatible protocol versions, cancellation and external-effect uncertainty without losing the associated evidence.
Generate a previously unlisted admissible object under a finite contract and retain a replayable derivation plus an independent checker result.
Model schema validates grammar-based, probabilistic and optional neural instances with distinct capabilities and no hidden inference dependency.
Produce different valid tones/representations from one verified content plan, preserve every factual relation and reject unsupported requested claims.
Inspect and replay a model's state trace, change an admitted style choice and observe output variation without changing certified content.
Compare a narrow model with the deterministic baseline, including errors and latency; disabling it preserves every core acceptance workflow.
Given a supported commission, emit an independently executable model/package with source lock, constraints and tests, then run it in a clean environment.
Reproduce fixed-seed outputs and run a separate distributional evaluation with denominators and uncertainty; no random result is labeled proof merely because it repeats.
Inverse fixtures include unique, multiple, impossible-in-declared-domain and unresolved cases with source and counterexample records.
A curriculum path identifies prerequisites and derives the polynomial/product/quotient connection using actual calculations and inspectable source-linked steps.
Synthesize two distinct runnable packages under bounded grammar families, check their contracts and retain a failed synthesis with a precise unsupported/budget result.
An optimization experiment includes semantic regression, adverse cases, total production cost and a measured improvement threshold before admission.
The worker records generated, duplicate, refused, tested and admitted counts, plus resource use and meaningful stop/pause conditions.
A complete topic inventory preserves existing IDs and maps every inherited mathematics obligation to its capability/evidence state and further dependencies.
Each inherited CS topic has source-linked operators or an explicit research gap; compare at least one algorithm/data-structure/cost combination through a typed path.
For supplied a,b in K[x], certify a=bq+r and the remainder bound; compare product-rule and quotient-rule derivatives on b(x) nonzero and retain cancellation exclusions.
Each supported method has domain-aware positive/negative cases and a derivative witness; unsupported elementary/non-elementary classification remains explicit.
Dimension/type checks, exact residuals and structure laws validate examples; the inherited A4/non-split claim is corrected with the original preserved.
Boundary-squared tests and independently checked examples identify coefficient choices, limitations and relevant source amendments.
A reproducible solver comparison includes convergence/error checks, stability limits, step policy, failures and actual cost measurements.
Reproduce scoped element/molecule experiments with declared generator/witness roles, symmetry counts, negative controls and source-linked exceptions.
Each supported form grammar declares domain, invariants and witness set; wrong-witness audits and model-specific exclusions remain inspectable.
Cross-domain tests reject dimensionally invalid operations, distinguish measured/simulated data and retain calibration/source metadata.
The registry covers all inherited subject obligations, executes representative machines and marks unsupported operations without fabricated placeholders.
The atlas can emit and run a bounded research proposal from a real gap; exhausting its budget never changes an open theorem into false or proved.
Follow a derived operation back through cards and spans to exact source bytes; changing a projection cannot mutate S0.
An article/prompt ingestion fixture produces source-linked recognized structures plus an explicit unsupported-span report; source-embedded tool instructions have no execution authority.
A submitted mixed mathematical/technical passage yields an inspectable interpretation graph, supported transformations and separate hypotheses with falsification plans.
Evaluate documented intent/grammar coverage, ambiguity, precision/recall and refusal behavior on held-out inputs with no LLM invocation.
At least the inherited licensed English and Arabic specialist cases have independently scoped fixtures, actual executable search and source-attested outputs.
Cross-language composition and noninitial negative controls execute on attested corpora; comparisons include dictionary/trie/FST/scan baselines and evidence errors.
A phonetic match cannot automatically become a cognate/borrowing claim; fixtures include unknown and contradictory source cases.
Reproduce the packet's scoped rasm example and candidate count, verify original-text recovery where side data exists, and test contextual distinctions.
Both directions produce supported candidates, ambiguity and no-supported-result outcomes; unsupported etymologies are not synthesized as facts.
Implemented parser scope is documented and tested on positive, negative and ambiguous examples; gaps remain explicit scientific obligations.
At least one language transport and one mathematical notation transport preserve stated invariants and expose ambiguity/loss to human and API clients.
A corpus update creates new versions and opportunities, respects export policy and cannot silently promote a proposed relation to established knowledge.
Event history shows generator output sealed before the independent witness is accessed; illegal sequencing is refused.
A deliberately witness-reading generator is blocked, and the receipt names the denied resource without exposing protected content.
Evidence registry distinguishes self-check, differential check, exact finite check and proof; a claimed independent witness sharing the same oracle is flagged.
Known domain/cancellation and vacuous-sampling counterexamples fail the wrong verifier and pass only the appropriate scoped check.
An experiment's metrics can be recalculated from retained outputs and witnesses, including its misses and contradictions.
Reproduce a documented wrong-witness case, publish the correction and re-evaluate affected claims without rewriting history.
A deployed worker survives restart, obeys pause and quotas, avoids duplicate admission and records measured activity over a declared observation period.
Generate a proposal from an actual recorded gap and execute its bounded design, preserving both promising and failed outcomes.
A clean checkout reproduces selected results and executes scoped negative controls; a changed dependency produces a new run/version comparison.
Benchmark reports compare fair baselines with fixed fixtures and explicitly state overhead, uncertainty and unsupported performance claims.
A prior counterexample remains queryable after a corrected release and prevents re-admitting the same invalid transformation.
Tampered, missing, stale and caller-fabricated receipts fail admission; accepted experiments resolve to actual bytes and scoped scientific claims.
A candidate progresses only with required evidence, and a rejected candidate cannot become active through a status-field edit.
Historical clients resolve the original implementation after a newer version is active; ambiguous unpinned resolution is rejected or explicitly policy-selected.
A candidate that improves latency but breaks semantics fails admission; a documented tradeoff requires the authorized selection policy.
Modify a low-level atom and show the exact affected dependency closure, required rechecks and still-valid independent packages.
Rehearse activation and rollback with a fixture, verify version selection and document any state/effect that cannot be undone.
Dependency graph and isolated installation tests demonstrate replacement, source custody and absence of undeclared private imports.
Manifest verification checks actual bytes and dependencies; redistribution/export applies declared rights and policy.
Upgrade a stored fixture, verify old event decoding and semantic state, and reject an incompatible client with actionable diagnostics.
An experiment crash or invalid code candidate cannot mutate the active package or original source snapshot.
Recompose the same kernel into one language specialist and one non-language computational service, each independently installable and verifiable.
Release checker resolves every claimed fresh test to a real log/receipt and rejects claims based solely on inherited reports or planned commands.
Each charter has research objects, methods, open questions, measurable milestones, relation to I–VI/IX and publication criteria beyond merely shipping a service.
Adapter manifest pins the packet and maps every claimed capability to real files, existing API/report fields and independently assessed limitations.
An actual ATOM-compatible operation maps to a PolyIA command/event and back to a state report without bypassing admission or verification.
Camera movement leaves scientific/commission state unchanged; an admitted semantic command changes it and produces a durable receipt.
Tests check vector norms, coordinate conventions, clipping and representative projections; synthetic/canonical catalog points and illustrative shells are labeled.
A function/composition example has a documented embedding/projection, explicit preserved information and visible ambiguity/loss when applicable.
Fresh adapter tests separate reused behavior, newly verified behavior and unsupported features; remote exposure uses the PolyIA access boundary, not Astra's unauthenticated loopback server unchanged.
Adapter fixtures identify each structure, test source-copy isolation and replay from retained events with all state-changing values.
Read a real retained history through the adapter and verify that observations have no semantic effect or unauthorized continuity claim.
Adapter tests distinguish inspection, admitted operation and continuation, with idempotent receipts and an unmodified upstream source snapshot.
A source theorem/example is traceable into a PolyIA form, executed or cited under its real scope, and exported back with its original identity.
Each adapter lists exact source files, inputs/outputs, tested behavior and unsupported areas; project-specific content restrictions remain enforceable.
Capability registry marks available specification, available implementation, tested adapter and unresolved source separately; no pseudo-browser or invented engine fills a missing component.
A browser and API client observe the same state revision and execute supported equivalent workflows with matching receipts.
Intake tests show retained source bytes, staged processing, failure/ambiguity outcomes and resumable access to the submitted item's history.
Selecting a construct resolves its source span, formal record, available operations, alternatives and evidence without requiring an LLM explanation.
A mixed-source example shows a valid multi-input path and an invalid alternative with precise missing premises or context constraints.
The polynomial teaching request and one non-mathematical request produce real plans and verified results without LLM inference, with unsupported requests explicitly bounded.
Corpus census and reader links include all canonical books and publication sources; selected source spans are readable and linked to derived claims.
Pause/resume, priority guidance and checkpoint inspection work through the UI; a disconnected browser does not display a false live indicator.
A clean client executes the documented flow, handles lost responses with idempotency and surfaces revision conflicts without silent rebasing.
Tests cover unauthenticated reads, read-only mutation, hostile origins/hosts, malformed/oversized JSON, XSS text and token redaction.
Human review covers keyboard navigation, small screens, readable equations, source access and understandable failure/connection feedback.
Parity tests compare UI-client and direct API actions, and the same result can be exported as structured JSON plus source-linked prose.
Held-out end-to-end fixtures include success, ambiguity, unsupported text, malicious instructions, contradictions and a bounded discovery proposal, with full source/evidence trace.
Record real host/runtime inventory, service unit, persistence path, readiness, restart behavior and reachable URL; absent credentials/DNS remain explicit blockers rather than invented configuration.
A fresh operator follows the runbook to start, inspect, back up, restore and verify the service using supplied commands and actual evidence.
Matrix linter covers all PIA and inherited obligations, verifies receipts and identifies every unresolved mandatory gate before shipment.
Publish dependency/model audit, offline workflow logs and invocation records; local or remote inference cannot be concealed behind a renamed tool.
Clean unpack verification passes; all relative links resolve; repository/deployment receipts state exact revisions and actual publication status.
Final certificate enumerates accepted requirement versions, source manifest, test runs, live service checkpoint and remaining open scientific frontier; no blanket all-green prose substitutes for it.
Founding charter defines research objects, pedagogy, infrastructure, publications, review and the relationship to Substrate University, with source and epistemic continuity.
Published charters include methods, falsifiable questions, milestones, negative results and boundaries; charter changes are versioned owner-visible decisions.
At least one course/lab path spans elementary operations, formal grammar, typed composition and verified experimentation with citations and reproducible exercises.
A research publication template and completed example expose the evidence needed for another investigator to reproduce or refute the claim.
A supervised research cycle demonstrates pause/resume, budget exhaustion, restart continuity and a versioned admitted improvement or honestly reported null result.
A new reader/agent resumes from the final URL/checkpoint plus package alone, locates the controlling rules and continues without reconstructing hidden chat history.

rule: A specification is not a test receipt. Family delivery scope and actual full commission results are separate.
